_meta.description: Updated Stage 1 (Onboarding / Registered) for the universal Anaplan product Delivery journey template. Slots into the larger template at stages[0]. Reflects iteration from Stage 1 review pass.
changes_from_previous: Added: partner-success-engagement task (new) — replaces assumption of a dedicated PSM
Modified: complete-resource-profile — effort upgraded from 15 min to 30-45 min to reflect expanded fields; manager info captured here as OPTIONAL, becomes REQUIRED to exit Stage 2
Renamed: confirm-{{PRODUCT_ID}}-focus → confirm-{{PRODUCT_ID}}-primary-focus (reflects multi-focus reality across journeys)
Decision: NO system-side stage-exit actions. Auto-provisioning of workspaces and workshop models is triggered within Stage 2, not on Stage 1 exit
open_items_parked_for_later: Resource profile field spec — to be locked as a separate work item alongside the data model
Computed time per stage — to be wired in once Stage 2 and Stage 3 task lists are locked
Parent-journey conditional logic — needs parent-journey concept defined as its own structural layer
Prereq recency policy (Anaplan Overview / Platform staleness) — program-level decision

_note: Stage 1 is mostly fixed across all products. Variable elements: confirm-primary-focus task title and primary-focus-confirmed gate description.
name: Registered
description: Partner resource confirms journey understanding, portal access, expanded profile, Partner Success engagement model, primary focus area, parent-journey enrollment if applicable, and prerequisite journey completion before product-specific work begins.

tasks.title: Review {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Delivery Journey roadmap & expectations
tasks.description: Walk through the 5 stages, computed time commitment per stage, the Expert outcome, and how multi-journey / parent-journey enrollment works. Sets expectations before any other work begins. Supports just-in-time enablement framing across the journey.

tasks._modification_note: Effort upgraded from 15 min to reflect expanded field set. Manager info captured here is optional at this gate; the requirement to populate manager info is enforced as an exit gate on Stage 2.
tasks.title: Complete resource profile
tasks.description: Capture firm, practice, prior delivery role, years on Anaplan, prior certifications and badges, region and language coverage, current utilization band, prior products delivered, and manager contact info (name, email, role). Profile is a living record — fields can be updated as the resource progresses across journeys.
tasks._profile_field_spec_status: draft — to be locked as a separate work item

tasks.title: Understand how to engage Anaplan Partner Success
tasks.description: Review the Partner Success engagement model — how to raise tickets, which Slack channels apply, and how to use the Partner Success agent. Replaces the assumption of a dedicated PSM, since access path varies between white-glove and long-tail partners.

tasks.title: Confirm {{PRODUCT_NAME}} as primary focus for this journey
tasks.description: Resources may hold multiple active focus declarations across concurrent journeys. This declaration scopes the current journey only, not the resource's overall product coverage.

tasks._conditional: Required only if resource is enrolled in a parent journey (e.g., a logical bundle such as IFP + FCR + AI). Otherwise auto-skipped.
tasks.title: Confirm parent journey enrollment (if applicable)
tasks.description: If this journey is part of a parent journey, confirm enrollment so progression, gates, and Expert outcomes are tracked at the parent-journey level.

gates.description: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Delivery Journey roadmap reviewed and acknowledged
Resource profile complete with Role = Delivery and required fields populated. Manager info is OPTIONAL at this gate and REQUIRED at Stage 2 exit.
{{PRODUCT_NAME}} confirmed as primary focus for this journey
Parent journey enrollment confirmed (only required if resource is enrolled in a parent journey)

_stage_exit_actions_note: No system-side actions on Stage 1 exit. Auto-provisioning of {{PRODUCT_NAME}} delivery workspaces and workshop models is triggered within Stage 2 and verified at Stage 3 entry.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Computed from task estimates excluding zero-effort verification tasks. This value is what the journey-orientation task surfaces to the resource as the Stage 1 time commitment.
